controls.name: C_chain_binds_all_three
controls.must_fire_because: an omitted input leaves two different histories with one chain root -- the link would not bind that input
controls.can_fail_because: an omitted input leaves two different histories with one chain root -- the link would not bind that input

controls.name: C_state_root_cannot_separate_histories
controls.must_fire_because: the two groupings give different STATE roots, in which case S73 already bound history and this spike is unnecessary; or equal CHAIN roots, in which case the chain adds nothing
controls.can_fail_because: the two groupings give different STATE roots, in which case S73 already bound history and this spike is unnecessary; or equal CHAIN roots, in which case the chain adds nothing

controls.name: C_forged_sequence_rejected
controls.must_fire_because: the chain accepts a sequence whose declared additions were never the ones applied -- then a prover can present a real state root reached by a route it invented
controls.can_fail_because: the chain accepts a sequence whose declared additions were never the ones applied -- then a prover can present a real state root reached by a route it invented

controls.name: C_referee_does_not_reexecute
controls.must_fire_because: the referee verifies more than one epoch, or takes more than ceil(log2 N) rounds -- either way it is doing work proportional to the run and has saved nothing
controls.can_fail_because: the referee verifies more than one epoch, or takes more than ceil(log2 N) rounds -- either way it is doing work proportional to the run and has saved nothing

controls.name: C_localises_every_epoch
controls.must_fire_because: any planted epoch, including 0 and N-1, is not the epoch the referee returns
controls.can_fail_because: any planted epoch, including 0 and N-1, is not the epoch the referee returns
